label: copy-phase update gate: short sequences (L<=4) or echoed g/y/0
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase (t > L), never on original tokens or the <DEL> step, and never on the first copy output (recall_idx 0). Within the copy phase it is strongly elevated for short sequences (L=3: 33% of steps, L=4: 17%, vs ~3-4% for L>=5), which hold ~56% of activation mass; strongest activations are L=3 sequences at recall_idx 1-2 (two steps after <DEL>). It is also modulated by the fed-back input token: g, y, 0 (and to a lesser degree r, 2, i, j, h) raise the rate 2-4x in sequences of any length. Activity concentrates near the end of the copy (to_go 0-2, ~81% of mass). Predicate (copy phase AND (L<=4 OR input in {g,y,0})) gets dev F1 0.50 / mass recall 0.78; the token dependence looks graded rather than a clean set, so precision is limited.
